displayScope.title: Displayed sections — {{company}}
displayScope.subtitle: Choose which menu sections and sub-sections are shown in this company: by role, by job title, or for a specific person. The most precise setting wins (person, then job title, then role). It hides screens; it changes no permission.
displayScope.alwaysShown: Always shown: it is the landing page.
displayScope.emptySection: No sub-section ticked: the section disappears from the menu.
displayScope.copyTo: Apply this setting to the other roles
displayScope.saved: The setting is saved. It applies the next time the company's users sign in, or as soon as they reload the page.
displayScope.saveFailed: Saving failed. Try again in a moment.
displayScope.loadFailed: The company could not be loaded: reload the page.
displayScope.adminOnly: This setting is reserved for the super administrator.

levelHelp.roles: Base setting, applied to everyone without a job-title or personal setting.
levelHelp.positions: A job title (the position on the profile) can have its own setting: it replaces the role's for everyone holding it.
levelHelp.users: A person can have their own setting: it overrides their job title and role.

displayScope.noPositions: No position is filled in on this company's profiles.
displayScope.pickPosition: Pick a job title from the list.
displayScope.pickPerson: Pick a person to see or set what they see.
displayScope.inheritsRole: No own setting: people holding this job title see what their role allows.
displayScope.inheritsPosition: No own setting: they see what their job title « {{position}} » allows.
displayScope.inheritsRoleNamed: No own setting: they see what their role ({{role}}) allows.
